artworks.title: Plate 8: Bearded Vulture with Two Birds of Prey
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of three birds perched on branches. The painting features three distinct birds, each resting on separate branches within a circular frame. The birds exhibit varying colors and postures. The bird at the bottom left has a reddish-brown body with a black head and wings, while the bird in the middle has a brown body and white accents on its head and wings. The bird at the top right is darker in color. The branches they stand on are barren. Surrounding the central image is Latin text in a classical font.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Man (recto)
artworks.medium: red chalk, with touches of black chalk, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of an elderly man in profile, turned to the left. He has a sharp facial profile with a long beard. His hair is unkempt. He wears a textured cloak draped over his shoulders. The background is a plain, lightly textured surface with some loose lines.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper; laid down
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man showing his upper body from just below the shoulders. The man is facing slightly to his right, with his face turned towards the viewer. He has curly dark hair, a prominent nose, and defined cheekbones. His expression is neutral. He is wearing a high-collared shirt or cravat and a dark coat with the collar turned up. There is a signed name at the bottom left of the drawing. The background is plain and neutral-toned, emphasizing the subject within an oval frame.

artworks.title: Apollo Standing in a River Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene featuring a nude figure holding a draped cloth. In the background, there is a cityscape with domed and spired buildings, and an arched bridge. The sky has textured clouds, while the trees on the left and right are finely detailed. The color palette is warm and mainly sepia tones. Another figure on horseback is also visible, adding scale and narrative to the scene.

artworks.title: The Centaur Family
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper

artworks.title: A Sacrifice to Pan
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash over red chalk on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures gathered in an outdoor setting with mythical and allegorical elements. The figures are depicted with dynamic poses and gestures. The use of reddish-brown ink accentuates the lines and curves of the bodies and fabrics. On the left, figures are engaged in action or interaction, while the right side shows two figures near a pedestal or drum. The flowing drapery and idealized form of the figures contribute to a classical or baroque style. The drawing suggests themes of mythology, allegory, or religious narrative.

artworks.title: Studies for Judith and Holofernes, David and Goliath, The Finding of Moses, and Others [recto]
artworks.medium:
a) pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
b) pen and brown ink and wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures and scenes sketched in brown ink on paper. The drawing displays a collection of human figures in various poses, composed in a manner that appears to be somewhat chaotic and spontaneous. The style is reminiscent of preparatory sketches, with loose and flowing lines capturing the dynamic postures of the figures. In the upper section, some figures appear to be reclining or gathered, possibly engaged in an interaction or conversation, while others seem to be caught in motion. Scattered around the page are additional figures that appear to be standing or walking, identified with suggestions of cloaked garments. There are also hints of architectural forms and possibly natural elements, like hills or rocks implied by the curves and shading. The presence of handwritten notations or text fragments adds to the chaotic and detailed nature of the work. The overlapping sections and partial renderings of figures give the drawing an unfinished, exploratory quality, typical of sketches meant to capture a burst of ideas.

artworks.title: Studies for the Raising of Lazarus and Other Compositions [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows several sketches and handwritten notes on a paper. The sketches feature human figures in different poses and activities. The handwritten notes, possibly in Italian, accompany the illustrations in cursive handwriting. The figures are rough and incomplete, typical of artistic studies or drafts.

artworks.title: Village along a River Estuary in Devon
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on oatmeal paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a broad expanse. The horizon is low in the composition above buildings and ship masts on the distant shore. The sky occupies most of the upper portion of the painting. Buildings with red-tile roofs and whitewashed walls line the shore, with ships' masts rising above them. The brushstrokes indicate a watercolor technique, giving a soft texture to the scene. The color palette is earthy with browns, greens, and grays. Cattle are resting on dark sand or soil in the foreground. Hills are visible in the distance with buildings reflecting in the water.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy with a Triumphal Bridge
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a perspective drawing of a large bridge with a rider on horseback statue atop it. The drawing emphasizes the detailed architecture of the bridge and the statue. Parts of the bridge's structure are highlighted with fine, controlled lines and shading. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving the drawing a historical feel. Figures and stone sculptures are seen close to the viewer, adding scale and liveliness to the scene. Background arches draw the eye into the distance, while the sky is lightly sketched to keep the focus on the bridge.

artworks.title: Gaiety and Grief
artworks.medium: red chalk with touches of black chalk on laid paper, laid down, with border lines drawn by the artist
artworks.dimensions:
overall (sheet): 12.7 x 7.9 cm (5 x 3 1/8 in.)
image (to border line): 10.8 x 6.3 cm (4 1/4 x 2 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. The first figure is standing, holding a staff with a banner that reads "L'Allegresse." They are wearing a draped garment, with one shoulder exposed. The figure has short, curly hair adorned with leaves or small flowers. The second figure is seated at the feet of the standing figure, with a hand on their head. The background shows rocky formations, sparse vegetation, and a textured ground.

artworks.title: Friendship, Useless Friendship, and Hate
artworks.medium: red chalk with touches of black chalk on laid paper, laid down, with border lines drawn by the artist
artworks.dimensions:
overall (sheet): 12.7 x 7.9 cm (5 x 3 1/8 in.)
image (to border line): 10.7 x 6.4 cm (4 3/16 x 2 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three figures positioned around a pedestal or column. The two visible figures are standing women, one holding a small bowl and the other reaching towards the pedestal. The third figure is partially visible, seated and holding an object. Above the pedestal is an inscription with decorative elements, with a sky background featuring flying birds.

artworks.title: The Celebrated Vincent Lunardi Esq. Accompanied by Two Friends in His Third Aerial Excursion, Taken from St. George's Fields, in London
artworks.artist: Francesco Bartolozzi after John Francis Rigaud
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, stipple engraving, and aquatint in brown on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: Three individuals are inside a hot air balloon basket. One man is on the right, leaning slightly forward, holding a hat in his left hand. Another man is on the left, gazing to the side with his left elbow on the edge of the basket. Between them, a seated woman faces forward with her head slightly tilted. The woman has curly hair with a feathered hat, while the men have powdered hair typical of the 18th century. The man on the right wears a formal coat with decorative buttons, and the man on the left wears a coat with a high collar and a cravat. The woman wears an elegant dress with a high, frilled neckline. The basket is decorated with fabric and fringe, and netting surrounds its lower half. Ropes and material imply a balloon above the basket. The background depicts etched lines resembling clouds.

artworks.title: Judith and Holofernes
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink  with brown and gray wash on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in a scene. The central figure is leaning forward with one leg bent, holding a sword pointed downward. Her facial expression appears determined, with neatly tied back, wavy hair. She wears a long, flowing garment. To her left, another person stands behind her, holding a piece of fabric. On the right, a male figure lies prone on a cloth-covered table, eyes closed, with short hair. The setting is indoors, with draped fabric and objects on a table in the background.

artworks.title: In the Hague Woods
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with trees stretching into the distance from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is not immediately clear due to the dense foliage. The painting features detailed brushstrokes, especially in the depiction of tree branches and leaves. The color palette is mostly monochromatic, with shades of gray and muted greens. The foreground shows tree trunks and underbrush, while the background comprises thicker clusters of trees.

artworks.title: Salome
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a woman holding a platter with a man's head on it, set in a landscape with trees, architectural structures, and mountains.

artworks.title: A Young Man Warming Himself at a Brazier
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated individual viewed from the back, with their entire body visible. The person is sitting on a cushioned surface, turned slightly to the left with one arm resting on their raised knee. The head is turned to look over the right shoulder, partially obscuring the face, with the eye and nose visible. The person has curly hair falling around the neck. The individual appears to be nude. Behind them, there is a small basin filled with water and fabric floating in it. The background is a simple, neutral space with no distinct features.

artworks.title: Head of a Boy
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait drawing showing the upper part of a person's body. The person is positioned slightly turned to the side, with their gaze directed downward. They have soft facial features with a serene expression. The hair is curly, framing the face gently, partially covered by a loosely fitted cap or cloth. The person's clothing is depicted with simple lines, suggesting a high-collared shirt or garment, with detail added to the folds and texture. The background is plain, with light shading that accentuates the subject without distinct details.

artworks.title: A View of Dovedale
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a mountainous landscape with an elevated perspective, showcasing a panoramic view of the natural scenery. The horizon line is low, with towering peaks dominating the scene. A small village and a stone bridge can be seen nestled between the mountains, beside a flowing river. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing fine textures of the rocks and vegetation. The color palette consists of earthy tones of greens and browns, complemented by blues and grays in the sky and mountains. The image features trees with varied foliage colors, suggesting a change of seasons. The overall effect is one of peaceful natural beauty, with bright light illuminating the landscape and casting subtle shadows.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 22 x 27 cm (8 11/16 x 10 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a natural setting with a family scene. The detailed engraving shows a lush landscape with foliage around a central scene. In the foreground, a woman holds a child. To the right, an older man observes with a gesture, and a donkey stands nearby. A Latin text is inscribed in the branches of a tree. The drawing is done in a classical engraving style with dynamic lines and cross-hatching for texture.

artworks.title: The Madonna on the Crescent
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Kimbell Art Foundation, Courtesy Ruth Carter Stevenson
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a crescent moon, holding and nursing a baby. She has delicate facial features, her hair partially covered by a draped veil. Her clothing is detailed with layers of fabric. A halo of stars encircles her head, with rays of light radiating outwards. The sky is filled with small stars and clouds.

artworks.title: Studies for an Annunciation [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Kimbell Art Foundation, Courtesy Ruth Carter Stevenson
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four sketched figures. The drawing depicts four figures, two on the left which are winged and seated on clouds, addressing two figures on the right, seated with draped clothing. Each figure is rendered with fluid linework, with emphasis on dynamic poses and expressions. The figures exhibit stylized forms typical of studies or preliminary sketches for a larger work. The composition of the drawing is balanced, with the figures arranged diagonally across the page.

artworks.title: Nude Man Seen from Behind [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Kimbell Art Foundation, Courtesy Ruth Carter Stevenson
artworks.description: The image depicts a person drawn in a sketch style. The figure is standing with the back facing the viewer, slightly turned to the left, and the head is tilted back. The facial features are not detailed, with the face turned away, and the hair appears to be short and wavy. The person is not wearing any clothing, and their physique is muscular, with emphasis on the back and legs. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the figure. The background of the image consists of the textured surface of the paper, with some faint sketches or markings visible.

artworks.title: The Lovers' Walk, No.2
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a slightly elevated point of view. It features a path or river winding through the scene, framed by trees on both sides. A house is visible in the distance. The style is characterized by sketch-like etching with detailed lines creating texture and depth in the foliage and pathways. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia. Trees with dense foliage arch overhead on the left, and shrubs are visible on the right. The path or stream leads to the house under the open sky.
